#!name=斗鱼直播
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/daoyu\.sdo\.com\/api\/userCommon\/getAppStartAd/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/rtbapi\.douyucdn\.cn\/japi\/sign\/app\/getinfo/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/staticlive\.douyucdn\.cn\/upload\/signs\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/staticlive\.douyucdn\.cn\/.+\/getStartSend/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/staticlive\.douyucdn\.cn\/.+?\/getStartSend/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/capi\.douyucdn\.cn\/lapi\/sign\/app(api)?\/getinfo\?client_sys=ios/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/capi\.douyucdn\.cn\/api\/ios_app\/check_update/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/capi\.douyucdn\.cn\/api\/v1\/getStartSend?client_sys=ios/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/douyucdn\.cn\/.+\/appapi\/getinfo/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/douyucdn\.cn\/.+?\/appapi\/getinfo/i then reject_img(200)

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, wan.douyu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, g.wan.douyu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, dotcounter.douyutv.com,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% daoyu.sdo.com, rtbapi.douyucdn.cn, staticlive.douyucdn.cn, capi.douyucdn.cn, douyucdn.cn
